title: gymnogramma ascensionis
intro: Gymnogramma ascensionis, commonly known as the Mountain Gymnogramma, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Gymnogramma ascensionis include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
